target_customer: Travelers with iPhones who wanted free offline city guides
problem: Travel guides on phones needed data connections abroad and were often generic; TomoGuides made handcrafted, personalized, offline guides that were free.
business_model: Free app; monetization not stated in any source found

founders.name: Montana Low
founders.background_notes: Only founder named on the YC page; team size is 2 and the second founder is not named.

technical_complexity.rationale: Offline iPhone guides with personalization; content creation was the larger effort.

defensibility.rationale: Content could be copied or replaced by free sources, and many offline guide apps existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent response. CB Insights says the company is dead.

market_need_then: No dated demand evidence was found beyond a Demo Day roundup listing the company.

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline says free, offline and just plain full of awesomeness, a casual tone.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press, logo information or community was found; the name is shared with many Tomo companies in search results.

outcome_analysis: TomoGuides was a two person YC Summer 2012 company building free offline iPhone travel guides. CB Insights lists it as dead with only about 20 thousand dollars from Y Combinator, and the YC directory marks it Inactive. No post-mortem, acquisition notice or other report explains the outcome, so the cause is not public.
notes: No company website is listed by YC and none was found, so there is no site to fetch. The 20 thousand dollar record rests on one database (CB Insights, seen via search summary) and appears to be the standard YC investment, so stage is other. A CB Insights comparison page labels it Acquired with Travora Networks and NileGuide as investors; no second source confirms this and it conflicts with the Dead status, so it is not used. Competitor searches returned only current CB Insights lists such as Smartvel and Tripoto, which are not dated near the batch, so the list is empty.
